# MM-P2-L2-IH01 Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1

Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01  
Revision: Rev D

Scope
This manual defines required maintenance activities, rationale, and records for Ring Rolling induction billet heater EQ-P2-L2-IH01. It covers routine inspection, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions needed to maintain safe and reliable operation. This document is intended for maintenance technicians and engineers responsible for furnace performance and material quality. Refer to ECN-2026-012, ECN-2026-048, and SOP-P2-L2-05 for related design changes, electrical schematics, and plant operating procedures.

Background and performance target
The induction billet heater is used to bring feedstock to forming temperature prior to ring rolling. The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C. Maintaining uniform temperature profile and consistent coil cooling prevents premature coil degradation and ensures repeatable ring geometry. Coil cooling water must meet flow requirements to avoid coil overheating; the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min.

Tools and consumables
- Insulation-safe temperature probe compatible with high-temperature billet measurement as called out in SOP-P2-L2-05.  
- Infrared thermometer for surface checks and verification.  
- Multimeter and clamp ammeter for electrical checks per ECN-2026-048.  
- Spanner set, insulated hand tools, lifting strap suitable for coil handling.  
- Replacement coil fasteners and insulation panels specified in ECN-2026-012.  
- Degreasing solvent and lint-free cloths for coil and connector cleaning.  
- Maintenance log forms and electronic entry device per plant document control.

Procedure
Preparation and safety
- Review SOP-P2-L2-05 and coordinate with line control before entry. Lockout and tagout all power supplies to EQ-P2-L2-IH01 and post signage at the line staging area. Verify absence of residual charge using appropriate procedures in ECN-2026-048 prior to touching exposed conductors. Wear heat-rated gloves and eye protection when working near recent heat cycles.

Visual inspection
- Inspect induction coil assembly for visible deformation, cracking, or discoloration indicative of overheating. Inspect coil insulation and fasteners for mechanical integrity. Check water lines and fittings for wetting, corrosion, or external leaks. Verify coil connectors are free from soot and buildup that would impede electrical contact.

Electrical checks
- With lockout in place and panels accessible, visually inspect bus connections and current leads. Clean contact surfaces with specified solvent and reinstall fasteners to recommended tightening practice found in ECN-2026-048. Confirm that protective covers and grounding straps are intact and secured.

Cooling system verification
- Restore control to cooling system only under supervision and permissive conditions required by SOP-P2-L2-05. Verify that inlet and outlet hoses are unobstructed and strainers are clean. Use flow measurement device at the coil water connection and confirm coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min. If flow is below this value, do not operate the heater. Trace the cooling circuit to locate restriction and repair according to plant piping maintenance practices cited in ECN-2026-012.

Thermal performance check
- After completing mechanical and cooling verifications, energize the system under monitored conditions as specified in SOP-P2-L2-05. Heat a billet and monitor temperature profile using the mandated probe placement and data logging method. Ensure billet temperature reaches the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C. Evaluate temperature uniformity across the billet length to confirm consistent heating. If target temperature is not achieved with correct power and feed settings per operating procedures, investigate coil impedance, power supply output, and refractory condition referencing ECN-2026-048.

Corrective actions
- Replace coils or insulation panels that show structural compromise as per parts list in ECN-2026-012. Repair water leaks with approved fittings and document component replacement in the maintenance log. If electrical anomalies are found, escalate to electrical engineering with test data and photographs attached.

Examples and rationale
- Example scenario: If measured coil cooling flow is marginally below the required threshold, a typical cause is a partially clogged strainer or a kinked hose. Cleaning the strainer restores cooling and prevents temperature excursions that reduce coil life. Rationale: Maintaining the specified minimum flow protects against coil overheating, which otherwise shortens service life and may cause rapid failure under load.
- Example scenario: If billets fail to reach target temperature despite adequate power, degraded coil turns or recessing insulation may be responsible. Rationale: Coil geometry and insulation determine coupling efficiency; restoring original geometry improves energy transfer and repeatability.

Acceptance criteria
- Visual: No visible cracks, deformation, or compromised insulation on coils and associated refractory at the completion of maintenance.  
- Cooling: Verified coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min at the coil inlet connection.  
- Thermal: Measured billet temperature reaches the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C during the validation heat cycle under standard operating feed and power conditions as defined in SOP-P2-L2-05.  
- Electrical: Connections cleaned and secured; no abnormal resistance or intermittent contacts recorded during post-maintenance checks as referenced in ECN-2026-048.  
- Documentation: Maintenance log updated with description of work performed, parts replaced as per ECN-2026-012, flow and temperature verification records, and name of technician completing the maintenance in accordance with plant record retention practices.

Records to keep
- Completed maintenance checklist and log entry per SOP-P2-L2-05.  
- Photographs of coil condition before and after work.  
- Flow measurement printouts or handwritten verification showing compliance with coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min.  
- Temperature data file proving billet reached the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C.  
- Parts replacement records referencing ECN-2026-012 and electrical test sheets referencing ECN-2026-048.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-012  
- ECN-2026-048  
- SOP-P2-L2-05
